description: Add warm analog light-leak overlays to your photos — pick the leak position, color mood and intensity.

faqs.a: Warm amber, sunset rose, golden hour and rainbow streaks — each built from layered radial gradients blended in screen mode like real light leaks.
Pick a corner or edge, or choose Random and hit it again for a new leak each time.
Yes — your photo never leaves your browser.

howto: Pick a leak position (or Random for a surprise).
Choose a color mood and drag the intensity slider.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Light Leak Effect
